parts.name: Rotation
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotating sash or pane of the window, made primarily of glass with a supporting frame.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the window to open and close, providing ventilation and access while maintaining visibility and insulation.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or pivots around a hinge or axis to open or close the window.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame or base body of the window, typically made of PVC or similar rigid material.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support for the rotating sash and ensures the window fits securely into the wall opening.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed support for the moving parts of the window.
